name: AI Probe (research)
description: Research: do the sentries' AI records (perception and behaviour) also run the enemies, and can they be made to lose you? Ctrl+Alt+F7 cycles break-contact: on (an enemy that has not sensed you for 3 s loses you and searches where it last saw you), observe only (counts, touches nobody), off; a HUD shows the mode and counts. Shift+F7 surveys the enemies within 60 m, F7 watches who is after you, Ctrl+F7 forgets you where they cannot sense you. Alt+F7 traces patrols for 30 s; Shift+Alt+F7 sends the patrols near you to your side. HUD needs Bingus Shared Loader and HD2Runtime. Host or solo. Turn off when done.
